equation.form: E[pts_i] = pace * (μ + α(Off_i − 50) + β(50 − Def_j)) [* units] + HFA_i + coach_i

justification.mu: Documented LEAGUE_TEAM_PPG. Scoring level, not a residual intercept.
justification.center: Documented 0–100 efficiency center. Empirically ~50.6/51.2 on Val-1.
justification.alpha_equals_beta: Offense and defense share the packaged 0–100 scale and SCORE_TO_INDEX_DIVISOR=68. Symmetry, not a fit.
justification.alpha_half: 25.9/136: each axis owns half of one linearized index unit. Giving both axes 25.9/68 is C3 and double-counts.
justification.pace: Scales possessions of the whole scoring rate, not a secret product on the mismatch only.
justification.units: A1 off (C1: units were not the E3 slope). A2 tests putting them back on the rate.
justification.possessions: 12.6 is the existing E4 scaffold. A4 must equal A1.

predeclared_candidates.label: E3 raw off_eff/def_eff ratio ** 1.00
predeclared_candidates.rationale: Lead ratio architecture. Mean bias almost gone; residual range still ~21. The ≥68 bucket is the compression baseline.

predeclared_candidates.label: C2 additive 0.5*off_idx + 0.5*(2−def_idx) (product form)
predeclared_candidates.rationale: Architectural evidence only. Do not ship. Do not fit 0.5/0.5. Still a 25.9 × matchup × units × pace product.

predeclared_candidates.label: C2 with (7, 55) team-score clamp off
predeclared_candidates.rationale: If ≥68 stays near 3 after removing the 55 rail, the missing high totals are the half-index slope, not the clamp.

predeclared_candidates.label: μ + (25.9/136)(Off−50) + (25.9/136)(50−Def), pace scales rate
predeclared_candidates.rationale: First-principles additive scoring in point space. μ=25.9 is the scoring level. α=β=25.9/136 is each axis owning half a linearized index unit — the C2 slope written without a matchup product. Units off (C1: units were not the slope). Pace scales possessions of the whole rate. No index clamp, no (7, 55) rail, so tails are the equation.

predeclared_candidates.label: A1 with unit offense boost × defense dampen on the rate
predeclared_candidates.rationale: Same additive rate as A1, then roster units scale the whole rate. Tests whether units belong in an additive engine or reintroduce a product.

predeclared_candidates.label: μ + (25.9/68)(Off−50) + (25.9/68)(50−Def) — C3 in point space
predeclared_candidates.rationale: Negative control. Full linearized index slope on both axes. C3 already showed a pretty mean and a worse residual range. If A3 looks calibrated only because it stretches tails, it fails.

predeclared_candidates.label: poss=12.6·pace, ppp = A1 rate / 12.6 (must equal A1)
predeclared_candidates.rationale: Possession-explicit rewrite of A1. Algebraically identical if poss=12.6·pace. 12.6 is the existing E4 scaffold, not a fit. If A4 ≠ A1, the implementation is wrong.

c2_compression_forensic.note: If E3's predicted-≥68 games actually scored near ~59 and C2/A1 project those same games near ~59, the missing tail is false amplification removed. If those games actually scored ~70 and C2/A1 sit near 55, the engine collapsed legitimate variance.
